Callout.Name: Abandoned Vehicle
Callout.Message: Vehicle abandoned in the road for several days.

Script.Line: It has been there five days. It is not mine and it is not anybody round here.
No plates on it and the doors are unlocked.
Nobody has touched it. I have been watching it out of the window.

Lines.Approach: Been there three days with no plates on it. Run it when you get there.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
